import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    ans = ""
    flag = False
    i = 0
    while i < len(s):
        # Check for "dot" replacement (three characters)
        if i + 2 < len(s) - 1 and i != 0:
            temp = s[i:i+3]
            if temp == "dot":
                ans += '.'
                i += 2
                continue
            # Check for "at" replacement (two characters)
            temp = s[i:i+2]
            if temp == "at" and not flag:
                ans += '@'
                i += 1
                flag = True
                continue
        elif i + 1 < len(s) - 1 and not flag and i != 0:
            temp = s[i:i+2]
            if temp == "at" and not flag:
                ans += '@'
                i += 1
                flag = True
                continue
        ans += s[i]
        i += 1
    sys.stdout.write(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
